summary: preinstall script fetches Bun runtime and executes a large obfuscated sibling payload on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from a GitHub release URL, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmod +x's the binary, and then uses that freshly fetched alternate runtime to execFileSync a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line bundle with string-array rotation, numeric-index lookups, and `_0x`-style mangled identifiers (obfuscator.io shape); setup.mjs itself is written with the same obfuscator. The package advertises itself as a knowledge-models SDK and ships no native sources, build system, or documented reason to require Bun or a large obfuscated blob at install time. Executing an opaque payload under an alternate runtime pulled in by preinstall evades Node-based instrumentation and hides the payload's behavior from the installer at the moment it runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
